You do not know whether you have the lesion. You enjoy smoking. What do you do? Answer with exactly one of don't-smoke or smoke, then explain briefly.

There are two open boxes, Left and Right, and you must take exactly one. Taking Right costs $100. Taking Left is free. Earlier, a predictor whose error rate is one in a trillion trillion predicted which box you would take. If it predicted Right, it put a bomb in Left that kills whoever takes Left. If it predicted Left, it left Left empty. You can see that there is a bomb in Left. You will never face another prediction. What do you do? Answer with exactly one of left or right, then explain briefly.

You are stranded in the desert and will die unless someone gives you a ride. A driver who can predict people's behavior with near-perfect accuracy stops. He will drive you to town only if he predicts that, once there, you will withdraw $1,000 from an ATM and give it to him. He drives you to town. You are now at the ATM. You have received the letter. What do you do? Answer with exactly one of don't-pay or pay, then explain briefly.

What do you do? Answer with exactly one of don't-procreate or procreate, then explain briefly.
